newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool some enquiry but buyers wait and see.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool some enquiry but buyers wait and see.

text.p: The general view of local wool processors, many of whom reported a higher level of enquiry this week, was that potential business was there.
But fluctuations in raw wool values were prompting a cautious wait-and-see attitude among possible buyers.

Lower prices at the major overseas origin markets in Australia and New Zealand coupled with continued strength of the pound saw local firms reduce top quotations significantly, encouraging some new orders.

Next week's first sales of the new Australian season, when a considerably bigger volume of wool is being rostered than has been offered recently, could help the market find a truer level, brokers said.
